title: Lovely Smoky Thai Reblochon Moo Ping
description: A smoky and snappy Thai dish featuring Reblochon cheese, poached to perfection in an earthenware bowl, with a Mediterranean twist, served in a moo ping form.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a blender, combine lemongrass, galangal, and kaffir lime leaves to make a smoky Thai paste.
In a large earthenware bowl, combine the Thai paste, coconut milk, fish sauce, lime juice, and palm sugar.
Add the sliced Reblochon cheese to the bowl and poach in the oven for 10 minutes.
While the cheese is poaching, prepare the moo ping form by cooking the Thai basil leaves in a little oil until crispy.
Remove the cheese from the oven and top with the crispy Thai basil leaves and sliced Thai chilies.
Serve the Lovely Smoky Thai Reblochon Moo Ping immediately in the earthenware bowl.
Garnish with additional Thai basil leaves and lime wedges if desired.
